g.title: VarkaIR
g.text: Varka IR: the sealed node families of VarkaVectorIR

branch varka-task-32-b2, 7 Sep 2026. A weight is the civil-from-days prefix plus the node's own tail (task 32 B2); the prefix is paid once per loop method. Fill: green = date output, amber = int field, violet = condition mask, grey = leaf. Edge = implements. A component named without a type takes any value node; the restricted positions say so.

g.title: Chrono
g.text: sealed: one civil-from-days prefix, one tail each

g.title: Cond
g.text: sealed: known-true / known-false words per lane

g.title: ColumnRef
g.text: an input's lanes; may be a derived int32 column (task 59)

g.title: NextDay
g.text: offset: literal k or the weekday leaf's column (59); weight 15

g.title: AddMonths
g.text: months: literal or guarded int column (60); decompose + recompose,

g.title: TruncDate
g.text: YEAR | MONTH | QUARTER in the shape; weight 31 + 16 / 5 / 31

g.title: TruncDateDynamic
g.text: level: the trunc-level leaf's column only; all four periods blended; weight 31 + 60 (task 61)

g.title: Compare
g.text: LT LE GT GE EQ in the shape

g.title: Not
g.text: swaps the two words, no code
